name: MicroWeather-Bench
description: MicroWeather-Bench is a benchmark for short-term, high-resolution local weather forecasting. It evaluates models' ability to predict meteorological variables (e.g., temperature, precipitation, wind) over fine spatial and temporal scales using spatiotemporal meteorological inputs. The suite measures forecasting accuracy across multiple horizons and conditions to compare time-series and spatiotemporal models.
reputation: A recent Hugging Face benchmark for micro-scale weather prediction; relevant to spatiotemporal forecasting researchers but not yet a broadly established standard.
